name: battle-messages-remaining
reviewNotes: Reviewed all original source sheets. The original 140 selected records cover ordinary messages. Ten additional 06-prefixed diagnostic-style records 12,13,16,19,47,49,52,86,92,175 translate mixed English/Japanese status text while preserving ordered controls and line breaks; native rendering and natural caller visibility require separate verification. Record 11 remains pending caller review because four dynamic fields share one original line.

Record 169 retains 02ae, dictionary index 14 (a802b1), whose nested index 17 is d6f7a1: the original four-cell spell suffix. Its dictionary translation must accompany future integration; the current width sample uses the original suffix. The third 09 field is a spell name; the fourth and fifth are another actor/suffix pair. Records 179/180 begin with a castle name, not an actor/suffix pair.
Do not duplicate frozen v45 entries or screenshot-battle-status-escape records 17 and 153. Preserve all ordered controls and battle terminators.

Width samples use an eight-cell actor plus two-cell suffix; stat labels at records 14,15,18 use three cells as in the existing battle-status evidence. Parenthesized name/reading record 25 uses six cells for each field. Record 135 has two actor/suffix pairs on one original line: its third through sixth fields use five-cell names and one-cell suffixes, requiring caller-specific native verification. These are static contextual samples, not complete runtime bounds.
